Solanum Pseudo-Capsicum.

Solanum. pseudo-capsicum. Jerusalem Cherry. N. O. Solanaceæ. Trituration or tincture of fruit.

Clinical.─Pupils, dilated. Somnolence.

Characteristics.─The few symptoms of this medicine were observed on a child who ate three or four of the berries.

SYMPTOMS.

3. Eyes.─Dilatation of the pupils.

11. Stomach.─Nausea.

12. Abdomen.─Very acute pains in lower abdomen.

26. Sleep.─Somnolence.
